label: All nine classical attributes of GOD_4 from its carrier-wide gift of esse
description: For each named God, causal ascent excludes any distinct cause of its esse at a maximum. The reviewed unity derivation uses this exclusion and the carrier-wide converse. Perfection and goodness use the same giver directly. The six remaining attribute proofs and the one-way sufficiency bridge apply at that same bearer. The logical equality splits retain excluded middle.
